verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hosted Git forge. A forge with built-in AI features could plausibly act as an MCP client, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no capability for Gitea to connect to or consume external MCP servers. The official gitea-mcp server (gitea-probe-3) is the opposite role: it exposes Gitea to agents rather than letting Gitea use other servers' tools, so it earns no credit here.
